categories.name: 链锯
categories.description: 专业与家用燃油、电池链锯，涵盖伐木、造材、劈柴等场景。

products.name: 460 Rancher（牧场主）
products.summary: 强劲的燃油链锯，适合伐木、劈柴与农场作业。X-TORQ 发动机扭矩大、油耗低。
products.summaryEn: Powerful gas chainsaw for felling, bucking and firewood cutting. X-TORQ engine delivers high torque with low fuel consumption.
products.description:
460 Rancher 是农场主和自用木材加工的可靠选择。配备富斯华 X-TORQ 发动机，提供更高扭矩和更低油耗与排放，Air Injection 离心式空气滤清系统有效延长使用寿命。

  • 大扭矩 X-TORQ 发动机
  • 自动油泵与多档位供油调节
  • 低振动设计，操作舒适
  • 加强型减震系统
products.descriptionEn:
The 460 Rancher is a reliable choice for farmers and self-use timber processing. Featuring the Husqvarna X-TORQ engine, it delivers higher torque with lower fuel consumption and emissions, while the Air Injection centrifugal air cleaning system extends service life.

  • High torque X-TORQ engine
  • Automatic oil pump with adjustable flow
  • Low vibration design for comfortable operation
  • Reinforced anti-vibration system

products.name: 550 XP Mark II
products.summary: 专业级林场链锯，获奖无数的 XP 系列。功率重量比出色，是职业伐木工的首选。
products.summaryEn: Professional forest chainsaw from the award-winning XP series. Outstanding power-to-weight ratio, the first choice of professional loggers.
products.description:
550 XP Mark II 是专业伐木工信赖的伙伴。新一代 X-TORQ 发动机配合 AutoTune 自动调校系统，无论海拔和温度变化都能保持最佳性能。

  • AutoTune 自动调校，无需手动调整化油器
  • 低至 4.4 kg 的轻量化设计
  • 新一代空气滤清系统，维护周期更长
products.descriptionEn:
The 550 XP Mark II is the trusted partner of professional loggers. The new-generation X-TORQ engine combined with the AutoTune system maintains optimal performance regardless of altitude and temperature changes.

  • AutoTune automatic tuning, no manual carburetor adjustment
  • Lightweight design from only 4.4 kg
  • New generation air filter system for longer maintenance intervals

products.name: 545 Mark II 专业链锯
products.summary: 为专业砍伐与造材设计的链锯，平衡性与耐用性俱佳，适用于长时间作业。
products.summaryEn: A chainsaw designed for professional felling and bucking, offering excellent balance and durability for long working sessions.
products.description:
545 Mark II 专为高强度的砍伐与造材作业打造，兼顾动力与操控性，配备加长导板后可应对大型原木。

  • 出色的平衡性设计
  • 坚固耐用的工程结构
  • 适用于连续长时间作业
products.descriptionEn:
The 545 Mark II is built for demanding felling and bucking work, balancing power and control. With an extended bar it handles large logs with ease.

  • Excellent balance
  • Robust and durable construction
  • Suitable for continuous long working sessions

products.name: 435 家用链锯
products.summary: 轻巧易用的家用链锯，Smart Start 智能启动技术让点火轻松可靠。
products.summaryEn: Light and easy-to-use residential chainsaw with Smart Start technology for effortless, reliable starting.
products.description:
435 是家庭园艺与庭院维护的理想选择。Smart Start 技术大幅降低启动阻力，LowVib 低振动系统提升使用舒适度。

  • Smart Start 智能启动
  • LowVib 低振动系统
  • Air Injection 空气滤清系统
products.descriptionEn:
The 435 is the ideal choice for home gardening and yard maintenance. Smart Start technology greatly reduces starting resistance and the LowVib system improves comfort.

  • Smart Start technology
  • LowVib anti-vibration system
  • Air Injection air cleaning system

products.name: 450S Rancher（牧场主）
products.summary: 针对农场与庄园场景优化的链锯，动力充沛、易于维护，适合日常粗重作业。
products.summaryEn: A chainsaw optimized for farm and estate use, powerful and easy to maintain, built for daily heavy-duty tasks.
products.description:
450S Rancher 为大面积割伐与农场日常作业而生，结构坚固，维护方便，是牧场主信赖的作业工具。

  • 坚固耐用的机身材质
  • Easy-start 启动技术
  • 便于维护的模块化设计
products.descriptionEn:
The 450S Rancher is built for large-scale cutting and daily farm work. Its robust construction and easy maintenance make it a trusted tool for ranchers.

  • Durable body construction
  • Easy-start technology
  • Modular design for easy maintenance

products.name: 350i Power Axe（40V 电池）
products.summary: 轻量化电池链锯，40V 平台供电，零排放、低噪音，居家庭院修剪更省心。
products.summaryEn: Lightweight battery chainsaw powered by the 40V platform, zero emissions and low noise for hassle-free home yard trimming.
products.description:
350i Power Axe 让修剪变得轻松：无需拉绳启动、无需燃油，一键按下即可切割。轻量化设计配合 40V 电池平台，随取随用。

  • 40V 电池平台，与同系列工具通用
  • 一键启动，零排放低噪音
  • 轻量化紧凑设计
products.descriptionEn:
The 350i Power Axe makes trimming easy: no pull-start, no fuel, just press a button and cut. Its lightweight design runs on the 40V battery platform.

  • 40V battery platform, shared with other tools in the series
  • Push-button start, zero emissions, low noise
  • Lightweight and compact design

products.name: T525 修枝链锯
products.summary: 轻量顶部手柄链锯，专为高空修枝与精细作业设计，单手操控灵活。
products.summaryEn: Lightweight top-handle chainsaw designed for aerial pruning and precise work, with flexible one-hand control.
products.description:
T525 采用顶部手柄设计，重量仅 2.7 kg，适合职业园林师进行高空修枝、断枝等精细作业。

  • 轻量化顶部手柄设计
  • 出色的功率重量比
  • 低振动，适合长时间精细作业
products.descriptionEn:
The T525 features a top-handle design weighing only 2.7 kg, ideal for professional arborists performing aerial pruning and sectioning.

  • Lightweight top-handle design
  • Excellent power-to-weight ratio
  • Low vibration for long precision work

categories.name: 推式割草机
categories.description: 自走式与手推式割草机，覆盖电池与燃油动力，适合各种草坪养护。

products.name: Lawn Xpert LE-322R（40V 电池）
products.nameEn: Lawn Xpert LE-322R (battery and charger included)
products.summary: 40V 电池自走割草机，切割浓密草丛更省力 30%，支持碎草、集草、侧排三合一。
products.summaryEn: 40V battery self-propelled mower that cuts thick grass 30% easier, with 3-in-1 mulch, rear bag and side discharge.
products.description:
Lawn Xpert LE-322R 配备无刷电机与 40V 可互换电池平台，大扭矩刀片电机让切割浓密草丛更轻松，4 段高度调节应对不同草况。

  • 无刷电机，切割效率更高
  • 3 合 1：碎草 / 集草 / 侧排
  • 可互换 40V 电池平台
  • 4 段切割高度调节
products.descriptionEn:
The Lawn Xpert LE-322R features a brushless motor on the interchangeable 40V battery platform. High-torque blade motor cuts thick grass with ease, and 4-step height adjustment handles different conditions.

  • Brushless motor for higher cutting efficiency
  • 3-in-1: mulch / rear bag / side discharge
  • Interchangeable 40V battery platform
  • 4-step cutting height adjustment

products.name: W520i（40V 电池）
products.summary: IPX4 防泼水设计电池割草机，无级变速自走，可收集、碎草、后排草。
products.summaryEn: IPX4-rated battery mower with variable-speed self-propelled drive, offering collection, BioClip and rear discharge.
products.description:
W520i 采用防泼水（IPX4）设计，无惧露水草地作业。无级变速自走驱动让推行更省力，可互换电池平台适配多种园艺工具。

  • IPX4 防泼水设计
  • 无级变速自走驱动
  • 可互换 40V 电池系统
products.descriptionEn:
The W520i features an IPX4 weatherproof design for dewy grass. Variable-speed self-propelled drive makes pushing effortless, and the interchangeable battery system suits a wide range of garden tools.

  • IPX4 weatherproof design
  • Variable-speed self-propelled drive
  • Interchangeable 40V battery system

products.name: W520（179cc 汽油）
products.summary: 搭载 179cc 川崎发动机的汽油自走割草机，大油箱支持全天作业。
products.summaryEn: Gas self-propelled mower powered by a 179cc Kawasaki engine with a large fuel tank for all-day performance.
products.description:
W520 配备强劲的 179cc 川崎发动机与大容量油箱，适合大草坪长时间作业，坚固的钢制底盘应对各种地形。

  • 179cc 川崎发动机
  • 大容量燃油箱，全天作业
  • 坚固钢制底盘
products.descriptionEn:
The W520 is powered by a strong 179cc Kawasaki engine with a large fuel tank, ideal for large lawns and long working sessions, mounted on a robust steel chassis.

  • 179cc Kawasaki engine
  • Large fuel tank for all-day performance
  • Robust steel chassis

categories.name: 机器人割草机
categories.description: Automower 系列智能机器人割草机，自动规划路径，省心维护草坪。

products.name: Automower 410 iQ
products.summary: 适合中小庭院的智能机器人割草机，可处理约 0.5 英亩草坪，支持实体线与虚拟线边界。
products.summaryEn: Smart robotic mower for small to medium yards, handling up to 0.5 acres with physical and virtual wire boundary support.
products.description:
Automower 410 iQ 让割草成为自动化：静音运行、自动返回充电、智能规划路径。通过手机 App 即可远程控制与调度。

  • 适用约 0.5 英亩草坪
  • 支持实体线与虚拟线边界
  • App 远程控制与调度
  • 低噪音自动割草
products.descriptionEn:
The Automower 410 iQ automates mowing: silent operation, automatic return to charge and smart path planning. Control and schedule it remotely from your smartphone app.

  • Mows up to 0.5 acres
  • Physical wire and virtual wire boundary
  • App remote control and scheduling
  • Low-noise automatic mowing

products.name: Automower 420 iQ
products.summary: 适合中大型庭院的机器人割草机，可处理约 1 英亩草坪，切割效率更高。
products.summaryEn: Robotic mower for medium to large yards, handling up to 1 acre with higher cutting efficiency.
products.description:
Automower 420 iQ 在 410 的基础上提供更大的切割效率，覆盖约 1 英亩草坪，同样支持 App 智能管理与自动充电。

  • 适用约 1 英亩草坪
  • 更高切割效率
  • App 智能管理
products.descriptionEn:
The Automower 420 iQ offers greater cutting efficiency on top of the 410, covering about 1 acre of lawn with the same app-based smart management and automatic charging.

  • Mows up to 1 acre
  • Higher cutting efficiency
  • Smart app management

products.name: Automower 440 iQ
products.summary: 面向大面积庭院的机器人割草机，可处理约 2 英亩草坪，高效省心。
products.summaryEn: Robotic mower for large yards, handling up to 2 acres efficiently and worry-free.
products.description:
Automower 440 iQ 覆盖约 2 英亩草坪，凭借更强的切割能力与更长的续航，是大型庭院的高效选择。

  • 适用约 2 英亩草坪
  • 长续航高效切割
  • App 远程管理
products.descriptionEn:
The Automower 440 iQ covers about 2 acres of lawn. With stronger cutting capability and longer runtime, it is the efficient choice for large yards.

  • Mows up to 2 acres
  • Long runtime and efficient cutting
  • Remote management via app

products.name: Automower 435 iQ AWD
products.summary: 全轮驱动（AWD）机器人割草机，可攀爬 70% 陡坡，适合复杂地形庭院。
products.summaryEn: All-wheel-drive (AWD) robotic mower that navigates slopes up to 70%, ideal for complex terrain yards.
products.description:
Automower 435 iQ AWD 配备全轮驱动系统，轻松应对高达 70% 的陡坡与不平整地形，智能传感器确保安全可靠运行。

  • 全轮驱动，可爬 70% 陡坡
  • 智能传感器与安全系统
  • 适用约 1.3 英亩草坪
products.descriptionEn:
The Automower 435 iQ AWD features an all-wheel-drive system that handles slopes up to 70% and uneven terrain, with smart sensors ensuring safe and reliable operation.

  • All-wheel drive, climbs slopes up to 70%
  • Smart sensors and safety systems
  • Mows about 1.3 acres
